step1_analysis.description: A folded-cascode or similar OTA topology used as a sub-block in the loop filter of a continuous-time or switched-capacitor sigma-delta modulator for IF reception.

paper_reference.title: A 13.5-mW 185-Msample/s Modulator for UMTS/GSM Dual-Standard IF Reception

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the OTA.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for the opamp (system SNR is 72 dB)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. For a cascode stage in SKY130, intrinsic gain is typically 40-60 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical folded-cascode OTA performance in 130nm technology.

GBW.description: Unity gain bandwidth of the amplifier.

paper_reported.value: System sampling rate 185 MS/s, IF 100 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm / (2 * pi * CL). To support 185 MS/s, GBW should be > 500 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Opamp GBW must be several times higher than the sampling frequency to ensure settling.

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard stability requirement for feedback systems.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A phase margin of 60 degrees is typical for optimal settling time without excessive ringing.

Power_Consumption.description: Total static power dissipation of the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. The opamp likely consumes a fraction of the total modulator power.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for 1.8V supply in SKY130, assuming the OTA takes about 30-50% of the total modulator power.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, GBW, phase margin, and power consumption of the OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameter definitions
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xmt2=5u L_xmt2=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xmt1=5u L_xmt1=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u
.param W_xm19=5u L_xm19=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N14 VB4 N18 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N20 VB5 N12 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VO_PLUS N17 N20 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N13 N12 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N18 VB5 LABEL_NET_2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N5 N1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N10 N19 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N19 N9 LABEL_NET_3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VO_MINUS N16 N13 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N1 VO_MINUS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XMT2 VO_MINUS VO_MINUS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmt2} w={W_xmt2}
XM12 N4 N1 VO_MINUS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XMT1 GND VO_PLUS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmt1} w={W_xmt1}
XM14 N8 CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 VO_PLUS VB3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 VO_MINUS VB3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N1 VB3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM18 N14 N4 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}
XM19 N14 VIN_PLUS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm19} w={W_xm19}

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB4 VB4 0 0.99
VVB5 VB5 0 0.99
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VVB3 VB3 0 0.54
VVIN_PLUS VIN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

* Missing Biases for floating gates
VN17 N17 0 0.5
VN12 N12 0 0.9
VN9 N9 0 0.9
VN10 N10 0 0.5
VN16 N16 0 0.5
VCMFB CMFB 0 0.9

* Load Capacitors
CL1 VO_PLUS 0 1p
CL2 VO_MINUS 0 1p

.control
* Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VO_PLUS)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VO_PLUS))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 2u
meas tran v_max max v(VO_PLUS)
meas tran v_min min v(VO_PLUS)

quit
.endc
.end
